crew.overview: American expat Mickey Pearson has built a highly profitable marijuana empire in London. When word gets out that he’s looking to cash out of the business forever it triggers plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.
crew.title: The Gentlemen

details.biography: Lauren Bond is an Actor, Producer, Director and Writer and is known for The Gentlemen (2019), The Perfection (2018) and Drive Through Fire. She has worked for Miramax and is currently manager of development and aquisitions at Red Sea Media, Inc
details.name: Lauren Bond
